description: Demolition of existing bungalow and erection of a 6 bedroom bungalow with associated landscaping and parking.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1). With appropriate safeguarding condition the proposed bungalow, because of its size, design and appearance, would complement the appearance of the locality and would comply with the Council's housing layout standards. It would not harm neighbours' living conditions. The development complies with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.4.1 (Housing Standards and Guidelines), T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities For Developments) and H.6.3 (Backland Development/Infill Development).
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 5 - Before commencement of operations, a scheme shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority to cover the following matters:

(i)	any external illumination of the site

(ii)	measures to ensure that all mud and other loose materials are not carried on the wheels and chassis of any vehicles leaving the site; and

(iii)	measures to minimise dust nuisance caused by the operations and to ensure that no dust or other debris is carried on to the adjoining properties.

The scheme so approved should be fully implemented.
Condition : 6 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the any wall of the building hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development Order) 1995 (or any order revoking or re-enacting that order) no enlargement of the premises or any additional structures/buildings within the curtilage of the site shall be carried out.

Condition : 9 - A splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of the access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays.

Condition : 11 - No development shall take place until there has been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority a plan indicating the positions, design, materials and type of boundary treatment to be erected.  The boundary treatment shall be completed before (the use hereby permitted is commenced) or (before the building(s) is/are occupied) or (in accordance with a timetable agreed in writing with the local planning authority).  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 12 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8am to  6pm  on Mondays to Friday and 8am  to 12pm  on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 13 - Informative

Samples provided for Condition B4 should include  a sample of the paving proposed for the forecourt.

Condition : 14 - The access doorway to No.33 Lime Tree Road shall have a minimum clear width of 900mm, a level surface or ramp between the pavement and the floor and a door handle of not more than 1m above ground level.

Condition : 15 - In this condition "retained tree" means an existing tree which is to be retained in accordance with the approved plans and particulars; and paragraphs (a) and (b)  below shall have effect until the expiration of (5 years?) from (the date of the occupation of the building for its permitted use).

(a)	No retained tree shall be cut down, uprooted or destroyed, nor shall any retained tree be topped or lopped other than in accordance with the approved plans and particulars, without the written approval of the local planning authority.  Any topping or lopping approved shall be carried out in accordance with British Standard[3998 (Tree Work)] or any other BS replacing.

(b)	If any retained tree is removed, uprooted or destroyed or dies, another tree shall be planted at the same place and that tree shall be of such size and species, and shall be planted at such time, as may be specified in writing by the local planning authority.
